analysis.description: This correspondence addresses comments on a study about long-term outcomes of critically ill patients with hematologic malignancies during the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights the limited overlap of COHO study enrollment with the pandemic and argues against the pandemic's major impact on the study's findings.
